subject.title: fix(macos): stop replacement handoff retry storms

question: Does the macOS owner accept three bounded handoff attempts followed by supervisor takeover or manual restart as the supported recovery contract for installed app replacement?
rationale: This replaces the prior indefinite retry behavior with a user-visible availability policy, and the protected maintainer label requires explicit owner handling rather than automated cleanup.

options.title: Accept the bounded recovery contract
options.body: Approve the three-attempt policy after reviewing evidence that verified LaunchAgent ownership and unsupervised manual recovery both behave as intended.

options.title: Adjust the terminal policy
options.body: Change the retry budget, timeout envelope, or supervisor-yield condition if the supported deployment contract requires a different recovery guarantee.

options.title: Pause for broader update-flow design
options.body: Hold the PR if replacement ownership needs a shared macOS updater contract rather than logic local to this monitor.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded recovery contract
recommendation.body: Approve the three-attempt policy after reviewing evidence that verified LaunchAgent ownership and unsupervised manual recovery both behave as intended.
